# Creative exhibit

Contents: [Use cases](#use-cases), [Chart IDs](#chart-ids), [Minimal spec](#minimal-spec), [Data](#data), [Options](#options), [Annotations](#annotations), [Sizing](#sizing), [Fixtures](#fixtures).

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs from the boardplot describe, list and fixtures payloads. -->

Early alpha: an ad-creative review card with the creative media, observed metrics, account medians, daily trends and an optional authored fatigue threshold. Type `creative`.

## Use cases

- Ad-creative review (early alpha)
- Creative metrics against account medians
- Daily trend per creative

## Chart IDs

One form; its chart ID is `creative`.

## Minimal spec

```json
{
  "type": "creative",
  "options": { "title": "Creative review", "source": "Illustrative data" },
  "data": {
    "id": "example",
    "media": { "kind": "placeholder", "aspect": "4:5", "alt": "Creative media not supplied" },
    "facts": {
      "name": "Example creative",
      "format": "Image",
      "currency": "EUR",
      "spendToDate": null,
      "launchDate": "2026-09-01",
      "endDate": null,
      "asOf": "2026-09-01"
    },
    "comparison": {
      "startDate": "2026-09-01",
      "endDate": "2026-09-01",
      "population": "Account creatives active on this day"
    },
    "metrics": {
      "ctr": { "value": null, "accountMedian": null },
      "cpa": { "value": null, "accountMedian": null },
      "roas": { "value": null, "accountMedian": null },
      "hookRate": { "value": null, "accountMedian": null },
      "holdRate": { "value": null, "accountMedian": null },
      "frequency": { "value": null, "accountMedian": null }
    },
    "observations": []
  }
}
```

## Data

| Path | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| id | string | yes | Stable identifier for the creative. |
| media | object | yes | Embedded raster media or an explicit placeholder. |
| media.aspect (media branch 1) | string | yes | Authored media width-to-height ratio. One of `'1:1'`, `'4:5'`, `'9:16'`. |
| media.alt (media branch 1) | string | yes | Accessible description of the creative media. |
| media.kind (media branch 1) | string | yes | Media has not been supplied. One of `'placeholder'`. |
| media.aspect (media branch 2) | string | yes | Authored media width-to-height ratio. One of `'1:1'`, `'4:5'`, `'9:16'`. |
| media.alt (media branch 2) | string | yes | Accessible description of the creative media. |
| media.kind (media branch 2) | string | yes | Authored image media. One of `'image'`. |
| media.src (media branch 2) | string | yes | Authored image source reference; this contract does not fetch media. |
| media.aspect (media branch 3) | string | yes | Authored media width-to-height ratio. One of `'1:1'`, `'4:5'`, `'9:16'`. |
| media.alt (media branch 3) | string | yes | Accessible description of the creative media. |
| media.kind (media branch 3) | string | yes | Authored video represented by its poster. One of `'video'`. |
| media.poster (media branch 3) | string | yes | Authored poster-image reference; this contract does not fetch or play video. |
| facts | object | yes | Creative identity, currency and reported runtime. |
| facts.name | string | yes | Creative name shown to the reader. |
| facts.format | string | yes | Authored format name, such as Video. |
| facts.currency | string | yes | Three uppercase letters identifying the currency for spend and CPA. |
| facts.spendToDate | number \| null | yes | Cumulative spend through asOf in facts.currency; null means unavailable. |
| facts.launchDate | string | yes | First reported runtime date in YYYY-MM-DD form. |
| facts.endDate | string \| null | yes | Final runtime date between launchDate and asOf; null means still live at asOf. |
| facts.asOf | string | yes | Reporting cutoff date in YYYY-MM-DD form. |
| comparison | object | yes | Time window and population behind the authored account medians. |
| comparison.startDate | string | yes | Comparison window start date in YYYY-MM-DD form. |
| comparison.endDate | string | yes | Comparison window end date, no earlier than startDate and no later than facts.asOf. |
| comparison.population | string | yes | Authored definition of the creatives used for account medians. |
| definitions | string |  | The source's own definitions of its metrics, such as how hook rate and hold rate are measured; printed under the metric table as written. |
| metrics | object | yes | Observed performance and account medians; no fatigue conclusion is inferred. |
| metrics.ctr | object | yes | Click-through rate in percentage points. |
| metrics.ctr.value | number \| null | yes | Observed creative metric in the units named by its parent metric. |
| metrics.ctr.accountMedian | number \| null | yes | Authored account median for the comparison population, in the same units; null means unavailable. |
| metrics.cpa | object | yes | Cost per acquisition in facts.currency. |
| metrics.cpa.value | number \| null | yes | Observed creative metric in the units named by its parent metric. |
| metrics.cpa.accountMedian | number \| null | yes | Authored account median for the comparison population, in the same units; null means unavailable. |
| metrics.roas | object | yes | Return on advertising spend as a multiple. |
| metrics.roas.value | number \| null | yes | Observed creative metric in the units named by its parent metric. |
| metrics.roas.accountMedian | number \| null | yes | Authored account median for the comparison population, in the same units; null means unavailable. |
| metrics.hookRate | object | yes | Authored hook rate in percentage points; its measurement definition comes from the source. |
| metrics.hookRate.value | number \| null | yes | Observed creative metric in the units named by its parent metric. |
| metrics.hookRate.accountMedian | number \| null | yes | Authored account median for the comparison population, in the same units; null means unavailable. |
| metrics.holdRate | object | yes | Authored hold rate in percentage points; its measurement definition comes from the source. |
| metrics.holdRate.value | number \| null | yes | Observed creative metric in the units named by its parent metric. |
| metrics.holdRate.accountMedian | number \| null | yes | Authored account median for the comparison population, in the same units; null means unavailable. |
| metrics.frequency | object | yes | Average exposures per reached person. |
| metrics.frequency.value | number \| null | yes | Observed creative metric in the units named by its parent metric. |
| metrics.frequency.accountMedian | number \| null | yes | Authored account median for the comparison population, in the same units; null means unavailable. |
| fatigueRule | object |  | Authored fatigue threshold: the card compares the daily means of two windows and marks a change past thresholdPct. It has no default. |
| fatigueRule.metric | string | yes | Daily metric used in both comparison windows. One of `'ctr'`, `'cpa'`. |
| fatigueRule.direction | string | yes | Authored favorable direction; a change against it is worsening. One of `'higherIsBetter'`, `'lowerIsBetter'`. |
| fatigueRule.baseline | object | yes | Earlier daily-mean window. |
| fatigueRule.baseline.startDate | string | yes | Inclusive baseline start. |
| fatigueRule.baseline.endDate | string | yes | Inclusive baseline end. |
| fatigueRule.current | object | yes | Later daily-mean window, not overlapping baseline. |
| fatigueRule.current.startDate | string | yes | Inclusive current start. |
| fatigueRule.current.endDate | string | yes | Inclusive current end. |
| fatigueRule.minObservations | integer | yes | Required nonmissing daily observations in EACH window. |
| fatigueRule.thresholdPct | number | yes | Minimum adverse percent change from the baseline daily mean that triggers the authored rule. |
| fatigueRule.missingData | string | yes | Unavailable rejects nulls and missing calendar dates; skip excludes them, still requiring minObservations. One of `'unavailable'`, `'skip'`. |
| observations | array | yes | Daily observations in strictly ascending, unique date order. |
| observations[].date | string | yes | Observation date within the reported runtime, in YYYY-MM-DD form. |
| observations[].spend | number \| null | yes | Daily spend in facts.currency; null means unavailable. |
| observations[].cpa | number \| null | yes | Daily cost per acquisition in facts.currency; null means unavailable. |
| observations[].ctr | number \| null | yes | Daily click-through rate in percentage points; null means unavailable. |

## Options

| Path | Type | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| footnotes | false | `false` |  | false leaves the source line and the method lines (the account-median basis and the fatigue rule) off the card, for a host that shows them in its own frame; the texts stay in frame.source and frame.notes, and the fatigue status line stays on the card. No list of notes is taken. |

Plus the [shared options](options.md). This type does not accept `a11y`, `belowMinimum`, `margin`, `canvas`, `unit`, `unitShown`, `strings`, `format`, `detailFields`, `smallValues`, `labelDensity`, `labels`, `categoryLabels`, `labelPlacements`, `legend`, `valueAxis`, `categoryAxis`, `secondaryAxis`, `scaleGroup`, `rowLabels`, `sort`, `topN`, `bandFraction`, `highlight`, `story`, `focus`, `hatchStrength`, `colorblindSafe`, `rounding`, `annotations`.

## Annotations

This type takes no annotations.

## Sizing

Floor 320 × 270 px; fit `content`.

Below the floor a render is refused with `size-below-floor` and the pixels it needs. `measure` returns the natural and comfortable size for a given spec; see [Sizing in the manual](../manual.md#sizing).
